description: This file contains the implementation of the ModuleBuilder class in the SuiteCRM project. It manages packages and modules within the module builder, including listing, retrieving, saving, and building package data. It also includes logic for handling package aliases.

classes.name: ModuleBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for managing module building packages, including listing, retrieval, and construction of package data, as well as handling package aliases within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: getPackageList
methods.description: Lists available package names by reading the package directory and checking for manifest files.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an MBPackage instance for a given package name.

methods.name: getPackageKey
methods.description: Gets the package key from the manifest.php file within a specific package directory.

methods.name: getPackageModule
methods.description: Retrieves a specific module from a package and ensures the package is loaded.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds all loaded packages, with logic to handle whether there is a single package or multiple.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Ensures all packages are loaded into the object.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Returns a list of nodes representing all loaded packages.

methods.name: getModuleAliases
methods.description: Provides aliases for a given module name, such as related user or employee modules.
